Commentary.Commentary: Six games - four one-sided games and two washouts is how the 2017 Champions Trophy has shaped up so far. The tournament hosts qualifying means that three spots are now left up for grabs. South Africa could inch closer to booking their spot tomorrow if they win their clash against Pakistan at Edgbaston. Let's hope we finally have a close game in this tournament. The day-night game starts at 1330 local, 1230 GMT. Do join us for it. Let's hope the weather stays fine as it's been quite poor in that region. Until next time, it's goodbye from us.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson feels that restricting England to 310 wasn't a bad effort although it was a more than a par score eventually. Credits England's bowlers for doing a great job. States that he and Taylor were trying to set a base for the final assault but it didn't pay off. Opines that it was a tough surface for a new batsman to get going. Says that he failed to judge the bounce a bit and so that's how he got out. Accepts that his side's fate is now not in their hands due to the washout against Australia. Hopes that his side can win their last group game and then the other results can go their way.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that they were 15-20 runs short at the halfway stage. Reckons that with the batting line-up they have, 300 was par. Mentions that the partnership between Joe Root and Ben Stokes set them the perfect base but they failed to capitalise on it. Informs that they learned from the pitch after batting first. Feels that it was two-paced and the variations worked well for his bowlers. Adds that the fact that they bat till 10 helps them a lot as it boosts the confidence of their top order. Ends by saying that it feels great to reach the semifinals but they do not want to stop there as this group has a lot of potential.

Man of the Match, Jake Ball says that he was just trying to put the ball in the right areas and hoping something to happen. Reckons that in ODI cricket you should be ready to get hit all around the park. Informs that there was a bit of uneven bounce on the wicket which helped them. Ends by saying that they would look to beat the Aussies in the final group game and progress forward with another win under the belt.

England's bowlers were brilliant, especially with the new ball where they executed the plans to perfection. Ball was the standout bowler as his opening spell set the tone for the innings. Plunkett helped himself to another 4-fer as he mopped up the tail to complete a thoroughly professional performance. Earlier in the day, Root along with Hales and Buttler got England to a challenging score that proved too much for NZ.

Another one-sided game in this tournament, we're yet to have a close one. Chasing 311 was going to be tough on a two-paced surface but New Zealand did get some momentum through the Williamson-Taylor partnership after the openers didn't make much impact. However, once the NZ skipper departed, the innings capitulated quite meekly with no real fight whatsoever. In the end, they fell way short of the target.

OUT! ENGLAND QUALIFY FOR THE SEMIFINALS! They have lived up to their pre-tournament tag of being favorites. Shortish on off stump, Southee goes for the pull but miscues it high towards deep mid-wicket. Roy in the deep takes the catch with ease. Completes a dominating win for the hosts. They were on top throughout. ENGLAND WIN BY 87 RUNS.
Fuller outside off, drilled firmly towards mid off.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE BITES THE DUST! Back of a length around middle, Milne steps out to go big down the ground but skews it towards mid on. Rashid stationed there goes to his left to take a sharp catch. Another scalp for Plunkett, his third and England now just need a wicket to mop up the game.
Shortish on middle, pulled away on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Shortish around off, Southee goes for the pull but misses.
Full and on the pads, clipped towards the on side for a run.
Southee clips it away on the leg side for a single.
Four Leg byes! Fuller ball on leg stump, Southee misses the flick but enough pace on this and the ball goes off the pads towards the fine leg fence.
Mark Wood is back on.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Milne pushes at it but gets an inside edge that just goes past the leg stump. Beats Buttler to his left as well as the ball goes to the fine leg fence.
Tim Southee comes out to bat.

OUT! FINAL NAIL IN THE COFFIN FOR NZ! Anderson looks to go big on the leg side but miscues it high towards deep square leg. Hales settles under the skier comfortably to send the Kiwi all-rounder on his way. That should be the game for England. Not that Anderson or NZ were threatening to gun this down in the recent few overs but for the sake of academic interests.
On a length outside off, dabbed towards point for a single. Shy at the bowler's end misses, wouldn't have mattered anyway.
Dug in short around off, Milne looks to pull but is hit on the body as the ball rolls to the right of the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, steered towards short third man as the batsmen take a single.
Liam Plunkett is back.
Floated around off, gets back and blocks it solidly.
Flighted around middle, Milne pushes with hard hands and gets an inside edge through backward square leg for a single.
Drifting in around middle, Milne gets an inside edge towards the leg side.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly.
Floated around middle, gets across and clips it through backward square leg for a single.
DROPPED! Rashid has dropped a simple chance. Tossed up outside off, Milne drives it straight back at the bowler who spills a regulation chance. Palms it towards mid off as the batsmen take a single.
Adam Milne is the new man in.

OUT! ANOTHER ONE FALLS! This is a flighted full toss around leg stump, Santner steps out to dig it out but misses. Buttler takes it well and whips off the bails comfortably. Santner was well down the track and that's the second scalp for Adil. Good stuff by Buttler as he was blinded by the batsman but did really well. It's a wide but that's okay for stumpings. England romping towards a big win at the moment.

DOESN'T CARRY! Back of a length around off, Santner looks to flat-bat it down the ground but miscues it towards the deep. Ali from long on covers good ground and lunges forward but the ball falls short of him. The batsmen take a single. Surely there was a second run there.
Length ball on off stump, jammed towards cover for a single.
Slower and short outside off, Anderson thought of a leave but then decides to dab it late. Gets beaten eventually due to the lack of pace.
Speared well wide outside off, Anderson goes for a flashy cut but misses.
Length ball outside off, Anderson goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge on to the track.

FOUR! Slammed! A boundary for Anderson. NZ need plenty of these quickly to have some chance in this chase. Fuller length outside off, Anderson makes room and blasts this past the diving mid off fielder. The ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end.
Floated around off stump, gets back and across to clip it to the leg side for a single.
Floated on a length around off, nudged to backward point for a quick single.
Floated on a length on off stump, a bit of extra bounce as Santner looks to block off the back foot.
Shortened length around off, MS sits back to punch it but mistimes it down the track to the bowler.
Googly around off, Santner clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Shortish outside off, Anderson looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on to the track.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid on for a single.
Beaten again! Length ball outside off, Santner tries to put bat on ball but the ball goes past the outside edge.
On a length outside off, Santner tries to push at it but is beaten as the ball keeps a tad low.
Shortish outside off, Anderson cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Anderson hangs back and defends it to the off side.
Ben Stokes is back on.
Mitchell Santner is the new man in.

OUT! NO, IT HASN'T! Rashid has a wicket to his name. Lovely leg break around middle, Broom gets across to sweep but is struck on the back leg. Huge lbw shout and it's given by the umpire. After a chat with Anderson, the review is taken by Neil. No bat involved as confirmed by Hot Spot and Snicko. Ball Tracking shows the impact in line and going to clip the top of off stump. Umpire's call and so the on-field decision will stay. Broom has to go. NZ continue to implode. This run chase has hit a road block.
Broom has been given out lbw. He opts for the review. Has this spun a bit too much?
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks it to the off side.
Floated around off, Broom uses his feet and chips it inside out over extra cover. Long off comes across to his left to tidy up as the batsmen take two.
Floated outside off, stays back and cuts but straight to cover-point.
Flatter around off, crunched off the back foot to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, leans forward and blocks it to the off side.
Corey Anderson is the new man in.

OUT! NEESHAM FALLS! Plunkett drags his length short and forces a pull shot. It's struck fairly well but manages to pick out Hales at deep mid-wicket to perfection. England chipping away at the wickets with some wily bowling. NZ are under the pump. 120 needed from 78 balls.

SIX! CLUBBED OVER LONG ON! Good meaty blow from Neesham. Gets underneath the length ball and deposits this over the ropes for a biggie. Lovely strike with a clean bat swing. He's looked positive right from the outset.
Back of a length outside off, steered to third man for a single.

Back of a length around off, Neesham gets an under-edge onto the pads as the ball goes to point. Single taken. There was a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Broom was in anyway. Perhaps, Roy could have tried at the other end.
On middle and leg, clipped behind square leg for a single.
Good length around middle, blocked solidly towards the off side. Single taken.
Drifting in around middle, nudged gently towards the leg side.
Floated around off, Broom presses forward and defends solidly towards cover.
Fuller on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Neesham goes for the reverse sweep and is struck on the pads. Loud shout for lbw that is turned down. Rashid has a word with his captain and convinces Morgan to take the review. Has to be an optimistic shout at best. Hot Spot and Snickometer don't detect an edge. Over to ball tracking then. It's pitching outside leg and that's the end of that. Not surprising as it seemed like pitching outside the line to the naked eye itself. England have lost their review.
Appeal for lbw against Neesham. Didn't look that close to the naked eye but Morgan has somehow got convinced to use the DRS.
Drifting in around middle, nudged gently through wide mid on. Good running as the batsmen come back for two.
Floated around off, Neesham gets back and blocks it back to the bowler.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Shortish around middle, Neesham mistimes the pull towards square leg. Single taken.

FOUR! Clean strike! A touch full and around off, Neesham lifts it easily over the mid on fielder. Comfortably clears the infield and finds the fence. Much-needed one for the Kiwis. They need a partnership to get some momentum back.
Length ball on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Length ball around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length around off, skids through off the deck as Neesham misses the pull. Didn't rise as much as he expected.
Back of a length around off stump, Neesham gets back and blocks it solidly to the off side.
Length ball outside off, punched through the covers for a brace.
Back of a length on leg stump, Neesham clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Jimmy Neesham is the new man in.

OUT! BIG WICKET! Taylor succumbs to the pressure of the asking rate which was mounting a bit. Tries to whip a fuller ball uppishly but only pops it to short mid-wicket where Root takes an easy catch. No glory stuff from Ross today and New Zealand have lost both their set batsmen in fairly quick succession. England on top.
Length ball around off stump, Broom gets across the sticks to flick but gets an inside edge on to the pads. The ball rolls near the stumps as the batsmen steal a single.
Shortish around off, stays back to dab it on the off side but gets a bottom edge towards the left of the backward point fielder.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Fuller outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.
On middle and leg, Broom gets across and pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length outside off, cut away to third man for a single.
Shortish around middle, pulled powerfully to deep mid-wicket. On the bounce to the fielder who is a few yards up from the fence.

DROPPED! Nearly a blinder by Roy. On a length wider outside off, Taylor flashes it uppishly through backward point. Jason dives to his left and gets his fingertips but that's all he could do. The ball races to third man as the batsmen get a single.
Back of a length outside off, Taylor tries to steer it to third man but gets a bottom edge that goes on the bounce to the right of Buttler who makes a good stop.
Liam Plunkett is back.
Length ball around off, Broom defends it solidly off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Beaten! Ball has bowled really well today. This is on a length outside off, a bit of extra bounce and Taylor is beaten.
Too straight from Ball and it's worked on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length around off, Broom is struck high on the pads as the ball goes towards short third man. Stifled lbw shout from Ball but it was too high.

Nearly chopped on! Length ball closer to off stump, no room to cut but Taylor goes through with the shot. Gets a thick inside edge  that just goes past the stumps down the leg side. Buttler collects and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Broom was in though.
Shortish outside off, Broom rises on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Back of a length around off, Broom defends it firmly from the crease to cover.
Wood fails to go through with the delivery stride thrice in a row. The third time was due to the bails at the non-striker's end coming off due to the wind.
On a length outside off, Broom stays back and defends it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Broom gets forward and pushes it gently towards point.
Neil Broom strides out to the middle.
Time for Drinks! Can this wicket change the course of the match? England will be desperate for wickets while New Zealand want one more steady partnership.

OUT! Wood gets the much-needed breakthrough! Back of a length delivery outside off, Williamson stays tall and tries to dab it down towards third man. Gets surprised by the extra bounce as Kane gloves it. Buttler accepts it gleefully and sends the Kiwi skipper back to the hut. The Kiwis still need 153 from 118 balls.
Williamson pushes it through the backward point region for a couple.
Williamson dabs it towards third man for a single.
Williamson goes for the pull but he misses it completely.
Taylor stands tall and cuts it through the point region for a single.
Again dug short around off, Taylor defends it towards point.
Short delivery into the body, Taylor clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Williamson dabs it towards third man for a single.
Jake Ball is brought back for a bowl.
Length delivery into the pads, Williamson clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Williamson goes for the pull but he fails to make contact.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Williamson dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Short delivery into the batsman, Williamson ducks under it.
Angling into the batsman, Taylor clips it through square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Taylor mistimes his cut towards the fielder at point.
Taylor walks down the track and drives it towards long on for a single to keep strike.
Floats this one around off, Taylor waits for it and defends it neatly.
Googly around off, Taylor mistimes his push towards mid-wicket.
Eased down to long on for a single. 150 up for New Zealand.
Taylor dabs it towards the short third man region and calls for a quick single.
Darted down leg, Williamson clips it fine towards short fine leg for a single.

In the air...falls short! Banged in short, the ball kicks off the surface. Taylor tries to defend it but get surprised by the extra bounce. Hits the splice of his bat and the ball just falls short of the fielder at short covers.
Length delivery outside off, Williamson dabs it towards third man for a single.
Short delivery around off, Taylor stands tall and defends it with soft hands to scamper across for a single.
Fuller outside off, Williamson chips it over covers for a single. Was not totally in control of it.
FOUR! You don't bowl those to Kane! Fuller into the stumps, Williamson shows his class there by chipping it beautifully over the mid on region for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, Williamson defends it back to the bowler.
Mark Wood is called back into the attack.
Fuller into the pads, Taylor paddles it straight to the fielder at short line leg.
Williamson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Taylor mistimes his drive towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! A much needed boundary! Taylor gets to the pitch of the ball and clips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Tossed around leg, Taylor stays behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Good shot! Wide outside off, Williamson carves it over the cover region for a boundary.
Angling into the pads, Williamson fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire seems disinterested. Replays show it was going down leg.
FOUR! Good shot! Short into the pads, Williamson shuffles a bit and pulls it over the short fine leg region for a boundary.
Length delivery into the stumps, Williamson defends it on the off side.
Taylor dabs it towards third man for a single.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Taylor lets it through.

Leg bye! Angling into the batsman from a good length around off, Williamson shuffles across and tries to clip it fine. Fails to make contact and gets rapped on the thigh pad. The ball goes towards the short mid-wicket region for a leg bye.
Williamson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.

Fuller in the line of the stumps, Williamson dances down the track and goes downtown. The ball does not reach the fence as it sticks on the surface. A fielder chases it down and the batsmen run a couple.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Williamson goes for the slog. Gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.
Williamson gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
FOUR! Good shot! Floats this one down the leg side, Kane Williamson charges down the track and clips it through the wide mid on region for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
50-run stand between Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor! 5th consecutive 50-plus stand between these two.
Taylor drives it through covers for a single. Another good partnership between these two.
Taylor gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Beautiful! Short delivery outside off, Taylor cuts it over the point region. The fielder from third man tries to cut it off but the ball wins the race.

Nearly dragged on! Length delivery around off, Williamson tries to cut it but gets an inside edge to the keeper. Taylor calls for a single and Williamson responds well. The keeper has a shy at the non-striker's end which he misses.
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery into the batsman, Williamson pulls it over the square leg region for a boundary.
Williamson gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it down the ground for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

Stifled appeal for LBW! Drifting into the pads, Taylor fails to clip it through. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Good decision as the replays show it was pitched outside leg.
FOUR! Just over the fielder! Tossed up around middle, Taylor comes down the track and tries to clear mid on. He just manages to clear the leaping Jake Ball and the ball races away to the fence.
Taylor gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fuller around leg, Taylor clips it towards the fielder at wide mid on.
Williamson gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Good length delivery outside off, Williamson punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Wide! Short delivery into the body, Williamson sways away from the line of the ball. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Fuller into the stumps, Taylor digs it towards mid on for a quick single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
30th ODI fifty for Kane Williamson!
Fuller around off, Williamson drives it towards mid on for a quick single. Good knock from the skipper and he will want to make it count today.
Fuller around off, Taylor drives it through covers for a single.
Ben Stokes is back for a bowl.
Fuller around off, Williamson dances down the track and drives it towards mid on. Jake Ball fumbles there which allows them to take a couple.
Fuller into the stumps, Taylor clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats this one wide outside off, Taylor drives it crisply towards the fielder at covers.
Flatter around off, Taylor defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller into the stumps, Williamson drives it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, Taylor drives it towards mid on for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Williamson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Short and wide outside off, Williamson shuffles across and tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets beaten completely as the keeper collects it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! That was surely not what Williamson wanted! Short delivery outside off, Kane tries to duck under it. Cannot get his bat down and the ball kisses the bat and flies past the keeper through the short fine leg region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Williamson clips it through the front of square leg region for a couple.
A bit quicker outside off, Taylor cuts it towards the fielder at backward point.
Taylor gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Taylor plays the predetermined paddle scoop past the keeper for a brace.
Just over! Tosses this one in the line of the stumps, Williamson dances down the track but only manages to chip it just over the bowler's head through mid on for a single.
Floats this one on a fuller length outside off, Taylor drives it towards long off for a single.
Tosses this one around middle and leg, Williamson clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Adil Rashid is introduced into the attack.
Length delivery outside off, KW punches it towards sweeper cover. A single is taken.
Short delivery outside off, Ross Taylor hops a bit and cuts it through the point region for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Taylor gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, Taylor lets it through to the keeper.
Short delivery into the pads, Taylor clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Angling in from a length around off, Taylor defends it towards the fielder at mid on.
Short delivery into the batsman, Williamson ducks under it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson drives it through the cover region for a brace.
Taylor shuffles across a bit and nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Wide! Way wide outside off at a slower pace, Taylor lets it through to the keeper. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Fuller delivery outside off, Taylor drives it back to the bowler. Stokes dives forward to stop the ball in his followthrough.
Good length delivery outside off, Williamson wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Williamson gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
A good length delivery angling into the stumps, Taylor gets squared up a bit but still manages to dab it towards the fielder at second slip.
Another good length delivery outside off, Taylor shoulders his arms to it.
Nasty stuff! Good length delivery outside off, the ball kicks a lot off the surface. Taylor prods forward in defence. Gets hit on the gloves and then the ball goes onto hit his helmet.
Angling into the stumps, Williamson shuffles across and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

The NZ skipper takes out his helmet and takes a minute to cool off. The physio also comes in to have a look. Meanwhile, the scheduled drinks break has been taken as well. Superb start from England's bowlers. There hasn't been any real momentum in the chase so far.
OUCH! Short ball outside off, Williamson tries to duck but this doesn't rise as much as he expects it to. Cops a blow on the side of his helmet. Seems to be fine, thankfully.
Full and outside off, Williamson presses forward and defends towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, presses forward and defends it gently towards mid off.
Fuller and well outside off, Taylor goes for the big drive but mistimes it towards cover.
Short ball on middle stump, Taylor didn't know too much about that as he lets it sail over his head.
Ross Taylor walks out to bat.

OUT! STOKES HAS THE LAST LAUGH! Must say this is excellent captaincy from Morgan that has brought about this wicket. On most days against most teams, this would be a slice down to third man for a single. Not today as there is a man at where a proper fifth slip would be. Guptill's wild drive gets a thick slice that goes straight to Root who is stationed there. He takes the catch with ease and this is a huge blow to NZ's chances in this game.
FOUR! PUMMELED! Shortish and around off stump, sits up nicely for Guptill who stands tall to pull it over wide mid on. Clean strike and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
On a length around off stump, gets across and pats it towards mid on for a single.
Length ball on off stump, extra bounce and it hits Guptill high on the bat.
Four Byes! That's gone over everyone! Short ball that stuns Guptill due to the pace and direction. He tries to evade it and it sails over a leaping Buttler to the fence.
Just past gully! Back of a length outside off, Williamson plays with an angled bat. Just beats the diving fielder as it goes to third man for a single.
Another brace! Williamson clips it through mid-wicket for another brace.

Shortish outside off, Kane stays back and steers it through backward point this time. Third man tidies up by going to his right as the batsmen take another two. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two. It's been a sedate start but fairly steady as well.
Back of a length around middle, hangs back and works it through mid-wicket for a brace. Nice placement.
Full and just outside off, Guptill moves forward and defends it gently towards cover.
Full and outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.

BEATEN! Williamson is struggling a bit here. England have blocked his single-release shot to third man with a slip and gully. He still continues to try the dab but is being beaten quite a bit, just like in this case.
Fullish ball outside off, Guptill creams the drive through the covers. Single taken as there is protection in the deep.
Fuller ball outside off, Williamson shuffles across to drive and gets a slice past point for a single.
On a length outside off, sits back and punches it towards short cover where the fielder puts in a dive to stop the ball.
Ben Stokes is introduced into the attack. A bit of sawdust is being sprinkled near the bowler's landing area.
Shortish length outside off, extra bounce off the cross-seam delivery that hits Guptill on the splice of the blade. The ball goes to cover.
Length ball outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Bonus run! Fuller ball outside off, Guptill pushes it gently towards mid off as the batsmen steal a single. Direct hit at the bowler's end but he was well in. The batsmen take the second run as well.
Good length around off stump, stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Back of a length around middle, Williamson hops across and clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish outside off, stays back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Liam Plunkett comes on to bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Back of a length around off, Williamson tries to use the pace but gets a bottom edge on the bounce towards the right of first slip. Excellent first Powerplay for England with the ball.
Back of a length outside off, Kane sits back and punches it to cover.
Fuller on off stump, KW gets across to drive but spoons it towards mid on. Doesn't carry to the fielder there.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and steers it towards gully.
On a length on off stump, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Back of a length outside off, stays back to punch but mistimes it to the off side.

FOUR! CREAMED! Classy drive from Williamson. It's a fuller ball and he gets across to ease it past the right of the bowler. It goes down the ground and mid on gives a chase in vain as the ball races to the fence. Lovely timing!
Back of a length outside off, Williamson stays back and defends it to the bowler.
Full and on off, gets across mistimes the drive towards mid on.
Back of a length around off stump, Williamson stays back and dabs it to gully.
Fuller ball on off stump, Guptill gets across to drive but doesn't quite keep it down. Doesn't carry to the fielder at mid on. Rashid fumbles and that allows the single.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Back of a length outside off, a bit wide and Guptill punishes it. Stands tall to thrash it on the up through the covers. In the air but also in the gap as the ball rockets to the fence. That was hit really hard.
Back of a length outside off, punched sweetly off the back foot through backward point. Third man comes around to mop up as the batsmen take two.

FOUR! UPPISH BUT SAFE! Williamson clips it uppishly but wide of Hales who is stationed at short mid-wicket. Once it cleared the infield, it was always going to be a boundary. A bit risky but Kane pulled it off.
Back of a length around off, gets back and glides it down to third man for a single.
Length ball well outside off, Williamson dabs it past the gully fielder. Single down to third man.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, clipped to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson rocks back and punches it to the off side.
RIPPER FROM BALL! Wow! On a length just outside off, nips back in sharply off the seam to cut Guptill into half. It sneaks between bat and pad to the keeper.
FOUR! SLAPPED! Short and wide outside off, Guptill rises on his toes and slashes it powerfully wide of the backward point fielder. Excellently struck and third man had no chance of cutting it off.
Shortish and wide outside off, Williamson looks to cut but gets a slice that goes on the bounce past the diving gully fielder. Single down to third man.
Good length outside off, tapped gently towards gully.
Full and around off stump, pushed gently towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! SHOT! Lovely timing from Guptill! Fuller ball on off stump, gets across to that one and pushes it past mid on. Excellently timed and it races away to the fence for a boundary.

Lovely bowling! Both the England seamers have started excellently. On a length outside off, Williamson gets back to punch it through cover but is beaten comprehensively. No momentum whatsoever in the chase so far.
Fuller around off, driven down the track. Hits the stumps at the bowler's end and rebounds to the leg side. Single taken.
Good length closer to off stump, Guptill pushes at it tentatively and is lucky not to get a nick.

WILLIAMSON ESCAPES! Length ball outside off, punched sweetly towards the left of mid off as they look to steal a single. Plunkett misses the shy at the bowler's end as otherwise the NZ skipper was a goner.
Length ball outside off, stays back and punches it crisply but straight to cover.
Back of a length outside off, gets back to block it onto the track.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson stays back and pushes it towards point where Roy fumbles. Single taken.
Back of a length around off, Williamson gets back to punch it through cover but mistimes it to the off side.
Good length around off stump, Kane presses forward and blocks well.
Ball is forced to abort his run up as the bails came off at the non-striker's end due to the wind.
Almost carried! Fuller ball on off stump, Williamson gets across to drive but checks his shot a bit. Falls short of Ali stationed at mid on.
Fuller ball outside off, driven firmly back to the bowler who stops it in his followthrough.
More movement on offer. On a shortish length around off stump, nips in sharply to rap Guptill high on the pads. The ball goes towards third man as the batsmen take a leg bye.
Movement for Wood! Gets this to nip back in sharply off the seam. Williamson rocks back for the punch but is beaten on the inside edge.
Wood hits the deck hard outside off, punched firmly off the back foot towards cover.

EDGED BUT SAFE! A third slip would have gobbled that. Back of a length around off stump, Guptill hangs back to push at it but gets an edge that flies just past the second slip fielder. Single down to third man.
On a shortish length outside off, Guptill tries to cut but gets a bottom edge that rolls towards point.
Shortish outside off, Williamson hangs back and punches it through cover-point. Splits the gap and it goes to the deep. Allows the batsmen to take three.
Back of a length outside off, Kane stays back and defends towards cover.
Good length closer to off stump, Guptill gets across and defends it firmly towards mid on. This is an excellent start by Ball, successive maidens to start for him.
Back of a length around off, Guptill hangs back and dabs it gently towards the cover fielder.
On a length outside off, Martin gets forward and punches it towards mid off.
Short of a length around middle, Guptill defends it firmly on to the track by standing tall.
Back of a length on leg stump, Williamson misses the flick and the ball goes off the thigh pad to the leg side. The batsmen take a leg bye.
On a length outside off, tapped gently with soft hands towards gully.
Shortish outside off, steers it towards third man for a single.
BEATEN! That's a lovely delivery from Wood. Back of a length outside off, holds its line after pitching and whizzes past the outside edge. Williamson was undone by the extra zip off the surface.
Good length outside off, Kane rocks back and punches it to cover.
Shortish outside off, Williamson hangs back and pats it towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, stands tall and pats it towards cover.
Fuller outside off, Guptill gets forward and pushes it to the left of mid off. They scamper through for a run.
Mark Wood to take the other new ball.
Length ball closer to off stump, extra bounce as Williamson looks to defend. The ball goes off the outer half towards gully.
Good length closer to off stump, blocked solidly off the front foot down the track.
Kane Williamson makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Golden duck for Ronchi! Jake Ball does the talking with the ball this time. Angles this in from a length around off, Ronchi tries to defend it but gets beaten by pace. He finds his timber disturbed and Ronchi has to walk back to the hut. Just the start England needed.
Leg bye! Good length delivery and nipping in this time. Guptill cannot defend it. Gets rapped on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire says no and the batsmen scamper across for a leg bye.
Length delivery outside off, Guptill gets forward and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Back of a length delivery around off, nipping away. Guptill stays in the crease and punches it towards Morgan who puts in a good dive at cover.

Hurrah! The players are back in the middle! Martin Guptill and Luke Ronchi will open the batting for New Zealand. While Jake Ball will start with the first new ball for England. There are two slips in place. Here we go..
